# Velqiris (Chitara Trading)

> Deterministic pre-production MCP stdio conformance harness, secret redactor, bounded static scanner, and SHA-256 evidence bundler (`v2.1.2`). Zero runtime npm dependencies (Node.js >= 20).

## 9 Runtime Checks
- `PROC_START`: Direct spawn (`shell: false`) without shell interpolation
- `PROTO_INIT`: MCP `initialize` & `notifications/initialized` handshake
- `TOOLS_SCHEMA`: Unique tool names & JSON `inputSchema` / `required` checks
- `TOOL_RISK_REVIEW`: Metadata flags for high-impact tools
- `UNKNOWN_TOOL`: JSON-RPC error validation for nonexistent tool invocation
- `CONCURRENCY`: Parallel request ID correlation and envelope check
- `PROTOCOL_PURITY`: Flags non-JSON stdout framing corruption
- `SECRET_EXPOSURE`: Detects & redacts 10 credential classes (Anthropic, OpenAI, GitHub, AWS, Slack, Stripe, Postgres URI, private keys, Bearer, JWT)
- `CAPTURE_BOUNDS`: Bounded capture & `StringDecoder('utf8')` safety
